Messages.Author: Jonathan_Sicari
Messages.Body:
Does playing Golconda: Inner Peace on your own 10 cap independent
vampire meet the requirements for burning Judgment: Camarilla
Segregation?

Jonathan

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No, for two reasons:

1) burning a card by one effect isn't burning the card by a different effect.

2) Golconda doesn't burn the vampire; it removes the vampire from the game.
